"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const card=button.closest('[data-order-item]'),qty=card.querySelector('.quantity');qty.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,Number(qty.textContent)+Number(button.dataset.change)));let total=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-order-item]').forEach(item=>total+=Number(item.dataset.price)*Number(item.querySelector('.quantity').textContent));document.getElementById('basket-total').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(total/100);});
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');

}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
