<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}

  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
