<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}

  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
const tracks=[["Paper Lanterns", "The Quiet Hours", 214], ["Open Water", "Hana Reed", 198], ["Small Satellites", "Northbound", 242], ["Sunday Window", "Mira Vale", 173], ["Amber Streets", "The Quiet Hours", 205], ["Between Stations", "Hana Reed", 228]];let current=0,playing=false,elapsed=0,audio,voice,gain;const play=document.getElementById('play-track');function stopSound(){if(voice){voice.stop();voice.disconnect();voice=null;}}function startSound(){if(!audio)audio=new AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function show(){const track=tracks[current];document.getElementById('track-title').textContent=track[0];document.getElementById('track-artist').textContent=track[1];document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach((button,i)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===current)));play.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));document.getElementById('track-time').textContent=Math.floor(elapsed/60)+':'+String(elapsed%60).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+Math.floor(track[2]/60)+':'+String(track[2]%60).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('track-progress').style.width=(elapsed/track[2]*100)+'%';}function selectTrack(i){stopSound();current=(i+tracks.length)%tracks.length;elapsed=0;if(playing)startSound();show();}play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;if(playing)startSound();else stopSound();show();};document.getElementById('previous-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current-1);document.getElementById('next-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>selectTrack(Number(button.dataset.track)));document.getElementById('volume').oninput=event=>{if(gain)gain.gain.value=event.target.value/100*.08;};setInterval(()=>{if(playing){elapsed++;if(voice)voice.frequency.setTargetAtTime([220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][(current+Math.floor(elapsed/4))%6],audio.currentTime,.3);if(elapsed>=tracks[current][2]){playing=false;stopSound();}show();}},1000);show();
</script>

"use strict";
const tracks=[["Sunday Window", "Mira Vale", 173], ["Amber Streets", "The Quiet Hours", 205], ["Between Stations", "Hana Reed", 228], ["Night Garden", "Northbound", 191], ["Soft Geometry", "Mira Vale", 220], ["The Long Way Home", "Hana Reed", 237]];let current=0,playing=false,elapsed=0,audio,voice,gain;const play=document.getElementById('play-track');function stopSound(){if(voice){voice.stop();voice.disconnect();voice=null;}}function startSound(){if(!audio)audio=new AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function show(){const track=tracks[current];document.getElementById('track-title').textContent=track[0];document.getElementById('track-artist').textContent=track[1];document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach((button,i)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===current)));play.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));document.getElementById('track-time').textContent=Math.floor(elapsed/60)+':'+String(elapsed%60).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+Math.floor(track[2]/60)+':'+String(track[2]%60).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('track-progress').style.width=(elapsed/track[2]*100)+'%';}function selectTrack(i){stopSound();current=(i+tracks.length)%tracks.length;elapsed=0;if(playing)startSound();show();}play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;if(playing)startSound();else stopSound();show();};document.getElementById('previous-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current-1);document.getElementById('next-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>selectTrack(Number(button.dataset.track)));document.getElementById('volume').oninput=event=>{if(gain)gain.gain.value=event.target.value/100*.08;};setInterval(()=>{if(playing){elapsed++;if(voice)voice.frequency.setTargetAtTime([220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][(current+Math.floor(elapsed/4))%6],audio.currentTime,.3);if(elapsed>=tracks[current][2]){playing=false;stopSound();}show();}},1000);show();

<script>
"use strict";
const tracks=[["Between Stations", "Hana Reed", 228], ["Night Garden", "Northbound", 191], ["Soft Geometry", "Mira Vale", 220], ["The Long Way Home", "Hana Reed", 237], ["First Light", "Mira Vale", 186], ["Paper Lanterns", "The Quiet Hours", 214]];let current=0,playing=false,elapsed=0,audio,voice,gain;const play=document.getElementById('play-track');function stopSound(){if(voice){voice.stop();voice.disconnect();voice=null;}}function startSound(){if(!audio)audio=new AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function show(){const track=tracks[current];document.getElementById('track-title').textContent=track[0];document.getElementById('track-artist').textContent=track[1];document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach((button,i)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===current)));play.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));document.getElementById('track-time').textContent=Math.floor(elapsed/60)+':'+String(elapsed%60).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+Math.floor(track[2]/60)+':'+String(track[2]%60).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('track-progress').style.width=(elapsed/track[2]*100)+'%';}function selectTrack(i){stopSound();current=(i+tracks.length)%tracks.length;elapsed=0;if(playing)startSound();show();}play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;if(playing)startSound();else stopSound();show();};document.getElementById('previous-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current-1);document.getElementById('next-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>selectTrack(Number(button.dataset.track)));document.getElementById('volume').oninput=event=>{if(gain)gain.gain.value=event.target.value/100*.08;};setInterval(()=>{if(playing){elapsed++;if(voice)voice.frequency.setTargetAtTime([220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][(current+Math.floor(elapsed/4))%6],audio.currentTime,.3);if(elapsed>=tracks[current][2]){playing=false;stopSound();}show();}},1000);show();
</script>

const tracks=[["Night Garden", "Northbound", 191], ["Soft Geometry", "Mira Vale", 220], ["The Long Way Home", "Hana Reed", 237], ["First Light", "Mira Vale", 186], ["Paper Lanterns", "The Quiet AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function <script>
"use strict";
const tracks=[["The Long Way Home", "Hana Reed", 237], ["First Light", "Mira Vale", 186], ["Paper Lanterns", "The Quiet Hours", 214], ["Open Water", "Hana Reed", 198], ["Small Satellites", "Northbound", 242], ["Sunday Window", "Mira Vale", 173]];let current=0,playing=false,elapsed=0,audio,voice,gain;const play=document.getElementById('play-track');function stopSound(){if(voice){voice.stop();voice.disconnect();voice=null;}}function startSound(){if(!audio)audio=new AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function show(){const track=tracks[current];document.getElementById('track-title').textContent=track[0];document.getElementById('track-artist').textContent=track[1];document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach((button,i)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===current)));play.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));document.getElementById('track-time').textContent=Math.floor(elapsed/60)+':'+String(elapsed%60).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+Math.floor(track[2]/60)+':'+String(track[2]%60).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('track-progress').style.width=(elapsed/track[2]*100)+'%';}function selectTrack(i){stopSound();current=(i+tracks.length)%tracks.length;elapsed=0;if(playing)startSound();show();}play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;if(playing)startSound();else stopSound();show();};document.getElementById('previous-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current-1);document.getElementById('next-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>selectTrack(Number(button.dataset.track)));document.getElementById('volume').oninput=event=>{if(gain)gain.gain.value=event.target.value/100*.08;};setInterval(()=>{if(playing){elapsed++;if(voice)voice.frequency.setTargetAtTime([220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][(current+Math.floor(elapsed/4))%6],audio.currentTime,.3);if(elapsed>=tracks[current][2]){playing=false;stopSound();}show();}},1000);show();
</script>
