<script>
"use strict";
const tracks=[["Open Water", "Hana Reed", 198], ["Small Satellites", "Northbound", 242], ["Sunday Window", "Mira Vale", 173], ["Amber Streets", "The Quiet Hours", 205], ["Between Stations", "Hana Reed", 228], ["Night Garden", "Northbound", 191]];let current=0,playing=false,elapsed=0,audio,voice,gain;const play=document.getElementById('play-track');function stopSound(){if(voice){voice.stop();voice.disconnect();voice=null;}}function startSound(){if(!audio)audio=new AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function show(){const track=tracks[current];document.getElementById('track-title').textContent=track[0];document.getElementById('track-artist').textContent=track[1];document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach((button,i)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===current)));play.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));document.getElementById('track-time').textContent=Math.floor(elapsed/60)+':'+String(elapsed%60).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+Math.floor(track[2]/60)+':'+String(track[2]%60).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('track-progress').style.width=(elapsed/track[2]*100)+'%';}function selectTrack(i){stopSound();current=(i+tracks.length)%tracks.length;elapsed=0;if(playing)startSound();show();}play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;if(playing)startSound();else stopSound();show();};document.getElementById('previous-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current-1);document.getElementById('next-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>selectTrack(Number(button.dataset.track)));document.getElementById('volume').oninput=event=>{if(gain)gain.gain.value=event.target.value/100*.08;};setInterval(()=>{if(playing){elapsed++;if(voice)voice.frequency.setTargetAtTime([220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][(current+Math.floor(elapsed/4))%6],audio.currentTime,.3);if(elapsed>=tracks[current][2]){playing=false;stopSound();}show();}},1000);show();
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
const tracks=[["Amber Streets", "The Quiet Hours", 205], ["Between Stations", "Hana Reed", 228], ["Night Garden", "Northbound", 191], ["Soft Geometry", "Mira Vale", 220], ["The Long Way Home", "Hana Reed", 237], ["First Light", "Mira Vale", 186]];let current=0,playing=false,elapsed=0,audio,voice,gain;const play=document.getElementById('play-track');function stopSound(){if(voice){voice.stop();voice.disconnect();voice=null;}}function startSound(){if(!audio)audio=new AudioContext();audio.resume();gain=audio.createGain();gain.gain.value=Number(document.getElementById('volume').value)/100*.08;gain.connect(audio.destination);voice=audio.createOscillator();voice.type='sine';voice.frequency.value=[220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][current];voice.connect(gain);voice.start();}function show(){const track=tracks[current];document.getElementById('track-title').textContent=track[0];document.getElementById('track-artist').textContent=track[1];document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach((button,i)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===current)));play.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));document.getElementById('track-time').textContent=Math.floor(elapsed/60)+':'+String(elapsed%60).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+Math.floor(track[2]/60)+':'+String(track[2]%60).padStart(2,'0');document.getElementById('track-progress').style.width=(elapsed/track[2]*100)+'%';}function selectTrack(i){stopSound();current=(i+tracks.length)%tracks.length;elapsed=0;if(playing)startSound();show();}play.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;if(playing)startSound();else stopSound();show();};document.getElementById('previous-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current-1);document.getElementById('next-track').onclick=()=>selectTrack(current+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>selectTrack(Number(button.dataset.track)));document.getElementById('volume').oninput=event=>{if(gain)gain.gain.value=event.target.value/100*.08;};setInterval(()=>{if(playing){elapsed++;if(voice)voice.frequency.setTargetAtTime([220,261.63,293.66,329.63,349.23,392][(current+Math.floor(elapsed/4))%6],audio.currentTime,.3);if(elapsed>=tracks[current][2]){playing=false;stopSound();}show();}},1000);show();
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
let count=0;const score=document.getElementById('score'),note=document.getElementById('counter-note'),progress=document.getElementById('counter-progress');
function render(){score.textContent=count;progress.value=Math.min(count,30);note.textContent=count>=30?'Intention reached. Keep going if you like.':(30-count)+' clicks to your intention.';}
document.getElementById('increment').onclick=()=>{count++;render();};document.getElementById('reset').onclick=()=>{count=0;render();};
</script>

const list=document.getElementById('task-list'),input=document.getElementById('new-task');let taskId=0;
function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}
document.getElementById('todo-form').onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const text=input.value.trim();if(!text){input.setCustomValidity('Enter a task, not only spaces.');input.reportValidity();return;}addTask(text);input.value='';input.focus();};input.oninput=()=>input.setCustomValidity('');
["Prepare tomorrow\u2019s lunch", "Back up the travel photos", "Book a library visit"].forEach(addTask);
</script>

<script>

const list=document.getElementById('task-list'),input=document.getElementById('new-task');let taskId=0;
function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}
document.getElementById('todo-form').onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const text=input.value.trim();if(!text){input.setCustomValidity('Enter a task, not only spaces.');input.reportValidity();return;}addTask(text);input.value='';input.focus();};input.oninput=()=>input.setCustomValidity('');

function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}

const list=document.getElementById('task-list'),input=document.getElementById('new-task');let taskId=0;
function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}
document.getElementById('todo-form').onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const text=input.value.trim();if(!text){input.setCustomValidity('Enter a task, not only spaces.');input.reportValidity();return;}addTask(text);input.value='';input.focus();};input.oninput=()=>input.setCustomValidity('');
["Plan the weekend walk", "Reply to the studio brief", "Prepare tomorrow\u2019s lunch"].forEach(addTask);

const list=document.getElementById('task-list'),input=document.getElementById('new-task');let taskId=0;
function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}

function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}

<script>

const list=document.getElementById('task-list'),input=document.getElementById('new-task');let taskId=0;
function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}
document.getElementById('todo-form').onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const text=input.value.trim();if(!text){input.setCustomValidity('Enter a task, not only spaces.');input.reportValidity();return;}addTask(text);input.value='';input.focus();};input.oninput=()=>input.setCustomValidity('');
["Water the balcony plants", "Read one chapter", "Plan the weekend walk"].forEach(addTask);
</script>

const list=document.getElementById('task-list'),input=document.getElementById('new-task');let taskId=0;
function update(){const boxes=[...list.querySelectorAll('input')];document.getElementById('task-count').textContent=boxes.filter(x=>x.checked).length+' of '+boxes.length+' completed';document.getElementById('empty-tasks').hidden=boxes.length>0;}
function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}
document.getElementById('todo-form').onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const text=input.value.trim();if(!text){input.setCustomValidity('Enter a task, not only spaces.');input.reportValidity();return;}addTask(text);input.value='';input.focus();};input.oninput=()=>input.setCustomValidity('');

function addTask(text){const li=document.createElement('li'),label=document.createElement('label'),check=document.createElement('input'),span=document.createElement('span'),remove=document.createElement('button');li.className='flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border divider';label.className='flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0';check.type='checkbox';check.id='task-'+(++taskId);span.textContent=text;span.className='break-words';label.append(check,span);remove.type='button';remove.textContent='Remove';remove.className='text-sm accent font-semibold';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+text);check.onchange=()=>{span.style.textDecoration=check.checked?'line-through':'';update();};remove.onclick=()=>{li.remove();update();};li.append(label,remove);list.append(li);update();}

<script>
"use strict";
const form=document.getElementById('quiz-form'),result=document.getElementById('quiz-result');const questions=[["Which planet has the largest rings visible from Earth?", ["Saturn", "Mars", "Venus"], 0], ["What keeps a satellite in orbit?", ["Air pressure", "Gravity and forward motion", "Solar wind alone"], 1], ["What does a light-year measure?", ["Time", "Brightness", "Distance"], 2]];form.onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();let score=0;const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];questions.forEach((q,i)=>{const correct=Number(data.get('question-'+i))===q[2];if(correct)score++;lines.push((i+1)+'. '+(correct?'Correct':'Review')+' — '+q[1][q[2]]);});result.hidden=false;result.textContent=score+' / '+questions.length+' correct. '+lines.join(' · ');};form.onreset=()=>{result.hidden=true;result.textContent='';};
</script>

const form=document.getElementById('quiz-form'),result=document.getElementById('quiz-result');const questions=[["What is the most useful first step before a day hike?", ["Check the route and weather", "Pack only a camera", "Start at sunset"], 0], ["Why stay on marked trails?", ["To avoid all wildlife", "To protect fragile plants and reduce erosion", "To shorten every route"], 1], ["If a storm approaches, what should you do?", ["Wait on the highest ridge", "Shelter beneath a lone tree", "Leave exposed ground and reassess the route"], 2]];form.onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();let score=0;const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];questions.forEach((q,i)=>{const correct=Number(data.get('question-'+i))===q[2];if(correct)score++;lines.push((i+1)+'. '+lines.join(' · ');};form.onreset=()=>{result.hidden=true;result.textContent='';};

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
const deadline=Date.parse(document.getElementById('countdown').dataset.deadline);let clock;function tick(){let remaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor((deadline-Date.now())/1000));const values=[Math.floor(remaining/86400),Math.floor(remaining%86400/3600),Math.floor(remaining%3600/60),remaining%60];['days','hours','minutes','seconds'].forEach((unit,i)=>document.getElementById('timer-'+unit).textContent=String(values[i]).padStart(2,'0'));if(remaining===0){document.getElementById('countdown-status').textContent='The wait is over. Launch day is here.';clearInterval(clock);}}clock=setInterval(tick,1000);tick();
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
const deadline=Date.parse(document.getElementById('countdown').dataset.deadline);let clock;function tick(){let remaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor((deadline-Date.now())/1000));const values=[Math.floor(remaining/86400),Math.floor(remaining%86400/3600),Math.floor(remaining%3600/60),remaining%60];['days','hours','minutes','seconds'].forEach((unit,i)=>document.getElementById('timer-'+unit).textContent=String(values[i]).padStart(2,'0'));if(remaining===0){document.getElementById('countdown-status').textContent='The wait is over. Launch day is here.';clearInterval(clock);}}clock=setInterval(tick,1000);tick();
</script>

  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
const deadline=Date.parse(document.getElementById('countdown').dataset.deadline);let clock;function tick(){let remaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor((deadline-Date.now())/1000));const values=[Math.floor(remaining/86400),Math.floor(remaining%86400/3600),Math.floor(remaining%3600/60),remaining%60];['days','hours','minutes','seconds'].forEach((unit,i)=>document.getElementById('timer-'+unit).textContent=String(values[i]).padStart(2,'0'));if(remaining===0){document.getElementById('countdown-status').textContent='The wait is over. Launch day is here.';clearInterval(clock);}}clock=setInterval(tick,1000);tick();
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
const deadline=Date.parse(document.getElementById('countdown').dataset.deadline);let clock;function tick(){let remaining=Math.max(0,Math.floor((deadline-Date.now())/1000));const values=[Math.floor(remaining/86400),Math.floor(remaining%86400/3600),Math.floor(remaining%3600/60),remaining%60];['days','hours','minutes','seconds'].forEach((unit,i)=>document.getElementById('timer-'+unit).textContent=String(values[i]).padStart(2,'0'));if(remaining===0){document.getElementById('countdown-status').textContent='The wait is over. Launch day is here.';clearInterval(clock);}}clock=setInterval(tick,1000);tick();
</script>

Wait for the green signal next time.';}else if(phase==='ready'){result.textContent=Math.round(performance.now()-started)+' ms — your reaction time';}else return;phase='idle';pad.disabled=true;pad.classList.remove('ready');pad.textContent='Round finished';start.disabled=false;start.textContent='Try another round';};

<script>
"use strict";
const symbols=["PEAR", "ROSE", "BEE", "MOSS"],grid=document.getElementById('memory-grid');let first=null,locked=false,pairs=0,moves=0,pending;function startMemory(){clearTimeout(pending);first=null;locked=false;pairs=0;moves=0;grid.replaceChildren();document.getElementById('memory-moves').textContent='0';document.getElementById('memory-status').textContent='0 / 4 pairs matched';const deck=[...symbols,...symbols];for(let i=deck.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[deck[i],deck[j]]=[deck[j],deck[i]];}deck.forEach((symbol,i)=>{const card=document.createElement('button');card.type='button';card.className='memory-card';card.dataset.pair=symbol;card.textContent='?';card.setAttribute('aria-label','Reveal card '+(i+1));card.onclick=()=>{if(locked||card.disabled||card===first)return;card.textContent=symbol;card.setAttribute('aria-label','Card '+(i+1)+': '+symbol);if(!first){first=card;return;}moves++;document.getElementById('memory-moves').textContent=moves;if(first.dataset.pair===symbol){first.disabled=card.disabled=true;first.classList.add('matched');card.classList.add('matched');first=null;pairs++;document.getElementById('memory-status').textContent=pairs===4?'All four pairs found. Well remembered!':pairs+' / 4 pairs matched';}else{locked=true;const previous=first;pending=setTimeout(()=>{[previous,card].forEach(c=>{c.textContent='?';c.setAttribute('aria-label','Reveal a card');});first=null;locked=false;},700);}};grid.append(card);});}document.getElementById('restart-memory').onclick=startMemory;startMemory();
</script>

const maximum=100,form=document.getElementById('guess-form'),input=form.elements.guess,hint=document.getElementById('guess-hint'),history=document.getElementById('guess-history');let target,guesses=[];function newNumber(){target=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*maximum);guesses=[];input.disabled=false;form.querySelector('button').disabled=false;input.value='';history.textContent='None yet';hint.textContent='Seven attempts. Make your first guess.';}form.onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const value=Number(input.value);if(!Number.isInteger(value)||value<1||value>maximum)return;if(guesses.includes(value)){hint.textContent='You already tried '+value+'. Choose another number.';return;}guesses.push(value);history.textContent=guesses.join(', ');if(value===target)hint.textContent='Found it! The number was '+target+'. '+guesses.length+' attempts used.';else if(guesses.length===7)hint.textContent='Out of attempts. The number was '+target+'. Try a new number.';else hint.textContent=(value<target?'Too low.':'Too high.')+' '+(7-guesses.length)+' attempts remain.';if(value===target||guesses.length===7){input.disabled=true;form.querySelector('button').disabled=true;}else{input.select();}};document.getElementById('new-number').onclick=newNumber;newNumber();

const maximum=100,form=document.getElementById('guess-form'),input=form.elements.guess,hint=document.getElementById('guess-hint'),history=document.getElementById('guess-history');let target,guesses=[];function newNumber(){target=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*maximum);guesses=[];input.disabled=false;form.querySelector('button').disabled=false;input.value='';history.textContent='None yet';hint.textContent='Seven attempts. Make your first guess.';}form.onsubmit=event=>{event.preventDefault();const value=Number(input.value);if(!Number.isInteger(value)||value<1||value>maximum)return;if(guesses.includes(value)){hint.textContent='You already tried '+value+'. Choose another number.';return;}guesses.push(value);history.textContent=guesses.join(', ');if(value===target)hint.textContent='Found it! The number was '+target+'. '+guesses.length+' attempts used.';else if(guesses.length===7)hint.textContent='Out of attempts. The number was '+target+'. Try a new number.';else hint.textContent=(value<target?'Too low.':'Too high.')+' '+(7-guesses.length)+' attempts remain.';if(value===target||guesses.length===7){input.disabled=true;form.querySelector('button').disabled=true;}else{input.select();}};document.getElementById('new-number').onclick=newNumber;newNumber();

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  if(!form.reportValidity())return;

}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];

}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

<script>
"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
</script>

document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));

"use strict";
document.querySelectorAll('.local-form').forEach(form=>form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  const status=form.querySelector('.form-status');
  const start=form.querySelector('[name="checkin"]'),end=form.querySelector('[name="checkout"]');
  if(start&&end&&end.value<=start.value){status.textContent='Choose a check-out date after check-in.';return;}
  if(!form.reportValidity())return;
  const data=new FormData(form),lines=[];
  data.forEach((value,key)=>{if(key.toLowerCase().includes('password')||key.includes('card')||key.includes('security'))return;if(value instanceof File){if(value.name)lines.push('Resume: '+value.name);}else if(value)lines.push(key.replaceAll('-',' ')+': '+value);});
  status.textContent='Ready to review — '+lines.join(' · ')+'. No information has been sent or charged.';
}));
